        l, r = s.split('=', 1)
        return P(l) - P(r)

    s = re.sub(r'√(\d+(?:\.\d+)?|[a-z])', r' sqrt(\1)', s)
    _SUP = '⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹'
    s = re.sub('[' + _SUP + ']+', lambda m: '^(' + ''.join(str(_SUP.index(c)) for c in m.group(0)) + ')', s)

    s = s.replace('$','').replace('%','')
